# Third-party libraries

Bundled here so the app runs without a build step or `npm install`. Each is loaded only when needed.

| File | Library | Version | License | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `docx.umd.js` | [docx](https://github.com/dolanmiu/docx) | 9.15.4 | MIT | Building Word (.docx) files |
| `jspdf.umd.min.js` | [jsPDF](https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF) | 4.2.1 | MIT | Building PDF files |
| `pdf.min.js`, `pdf.worker.min.js` | [PDF.js](https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js) (pdfjs-dist) | 3.11.174 | Apache-2.0 | Reading text from PDF resumes |
| `mammoth.browser.min.js` | [mammoth](https://github.com/mwilliamson/mammoth.js) | 1.13.0 | BSD-2-Clause | Reading text from Word resumes |
